text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is beginning.
A crucial summer to prepare for the trial that is the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Fortunes rolling, ready to depart!
Onward, bus, straight to the south!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's finally time for summer training camp, isn't it?
Please, please guide me during this period~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: After all, fate is on the line. If we cannot find a ray of light, only death awaits. Happy or DIE!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit of an exaggeration...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-That might be true. But that just shows
how desperate I am!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, according to this good fortune map...
The training camp grounds are still a ways ahead.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this direction is quite favorable!
The direction of the Ox is undeniably auspicious.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's just keep pushing right ahead!
The further we go, the more good fortune we'll gather!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear? We've gone past the center point of the map.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Guh-gah?! That's the totally worst direction for bad luck!
Stooop! Bus, stooop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hauu, figures~. This summer really isn't
going to be easy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And that's exactly why I have to give it my all.
Bring on all seven misfortunes and eight sufferings! Your opponent
is my Trainer!

"...I'll have her fight her own battle.
Looks like it's going to be a hot summer."
